source.prompt: A belted kingfisher (Megaceryle alcyon), one adult perched upright with its wings folded tight, side-on pose. Realistic proportions: 32 cm long, a large head with a shaggy ragged crest at the back of the crown, a long heavy straight dagger-shaped black bill as long as the head, a stocky body, a short square tail, tiny legs. Slate blue-grey head, back and wings and a blue-grey band across the breast, a white collar around the neck, a white spot in front of the eye, white underparts; small white spots on the dark wing tips. No base, no perch. Game-ready, clean closed mesh.

tiers.note: Scaled to 0.32 m bill to tail. The preview's rock base, legs and long tail cut off; big head with the shaggy two-pointed crest and the long dagger bill kept; tiny dark procedural legs; a short square procedural tail (7 cm, 2.6-3.4 cm wide, fine white bars on lod0) at 35 degrees below level (raised from 58 so the tip stays above the ground); small black eye; flight wing cards (slate arm, black hand with a white patch at the base of the primaries on lod0, pale below). Colours: slate blue-grey head, crest, back, wings and tail; a white spot before the eye; a white chin, throat and a broad white collar right round the neck; a slate breast band; black bill with a grey base; black primaries with small white spots on the folded wing (lod0). COLOR_0 is the female (a rufous-chestnut belly band and rufous flanks), _COLORB the male (white there), as tools/build_turkey.py writes its hen. Triangles: lod0 1,000 = 701 body + 299 legs, tail, cards and eyes; lod1 400 = 315 + 85; lod2 120 = 93 + 27. GLB 251,296 bytes.

rig: bird rig template of the Steller's jay (tools/build_stellersjay.py; drawn with client/src/animalModels.js RIG.stjay's constants): PART BODY 0, LEG_A 1 / LEG_B 2 procedural legs (pivot at the knee), TAIL 3 procedural tail (pivot at the rump), HEAD 6 (head and neck, pivot at the base of the neck), WING_L/R 4/5 and HAND_L/R 9/10 flight cards that collapse into the shoulder on pose; extras.rig {kind 'bird', wing (shoulder), tail (rump), head (neck base), length_m}; no skin; aAnim2.w selects the male colour set (_COLORB), as the turkey's hen
accuracy_notes: Built 2026-11-05. Reads as a belted kingfisher: big crested slate head, dagger bill, white collar, slate breast band and (female) the rufous belly band and flanks. Still open: (1) upright, so like the owl it would fly 'standing up' under RIG.stjay unless the client pitches it in flight; (2) the tail angle is shallower than a perched kingfisher's (35 not 55-60 degrees below level) to keep its tip off the ground when it hops; (3) the rufous band is soft-edged and its centre blends toward white on large faces; (4) the white loral spot is a few faces, a little large; (5) the hover-and-plunge dive is not in RIG.stjay.
